_note: Text for the first-visit tour of build mode (issue #123), in ASD-STE100. The steps follow TOUR_STEPS in lib/game/tour.ts.
label: Tour of build mode

tasks.title: The task list
tasks.text: This list shows each task of the level. A tick means that the task is done. The ring shows the task that you do now.

connections.title: The connection list
connections.text: After a failed Check, this list shows each connection. A green tick means that the connection is right. A red cross means that it is wrong.

clear.title: Clear
clear.text: Clear removes the parts that you put in this level. To put them back, press Undo.

check.title: Check
check.text: When all tasks are done, press Check. Check tests your board. Check stays off until then.

build.title: Build it for me
build.text: This button shows the build, one step at a time. It clears your parts first. It does not give XP.
